data.body:
Implemented and merged: change 1059, commit 6f787da0529e.

The redirect record now travels back as a return value through all five layers, and `quiet=True` is unchanged.

Three of those layers were silently discarding it, none of which the original plan named — the forced plan review caught them, and without that the fix would have shipped as a no-op:
- the `_link` closure in `rebar.link()` called `link_core(...)` with no `return`;
- `_python_leaf` (`src/rebar/_lib_writes.py:483`) was typed `-> None` and called `fn(...)` at `:495` with no `return`;
- `rebar.link()` itself was typed `-> None`.

`_python_leaf` is shared by every Tier B leaf write, so it was widened rather than forked: forking would have duplicated its `CommandError -> RebarError` mapping, which is the single thing keeping the library exit-code contract uniform. Existing callers ignore the value, so the widening is additive.

`quiet` was NOT removed, and that is the point. rebar-mcp speaks MCP-over-stdio, so an unsuppressed print inside a tool call would inject a bare JSON object into the JSON-RPC stream. The same sink also protects the reconciler inbound apply, the code-review finalizer and the review-bot voter. The defect was that stdout was the ONLY channel, not that it is suppressed.

`link_tickets` keeps its `str` return, so its MCP outputSchema does not move, and reports:
    ok (escalated: {src}->{tgt} recorded as {rsrc}->{rtgt})

Testing note worth recording, because it nearly slipped through: an earlier draft of these tests stubbed `rebar.link` wholesale, so they passed while `_python_leaf` was STILL swallowing the value — a mutation that should have failed did not. The suite now runs the real chain end to end (`rebar.link` -> `_python_leaf` -> `_link` -> `link_core` -> `add_dependency`), and mutating either the `_python_leaf` return or the `_link` return turns it red. A regression case pins that `quiet` still swallows stdout WHILE the record still returns, so a future "just print it" change fails.

This closes the "Silent" impact of bug 1803-df54-18bb-4881 on the library and MCP paths. Escalation was already correct after story affe-2b42-4ee4-4e12; it is now also visible to the callers agents actually use.

Gates: make lint, make typecheck, 102 tests in tests/scripts/graph/ + tests/unit/test_mcp_writes.py. LLM-Review +1, Verified +1.
